channel.title: VendorIndex — price & data changes
channel.description: Cited pricing and data changes across the vendors VendorIndex tracks, newest first.

item.title: Zep — monthly pricing (2026-11-04)
item.description: new: Flex plan $125/month (as of July 2026; the '$25' seen online is a credit top-up, not the plan price). Meters ingested Episodes at 1 credit / 350 bytes; retrieval, storage and users are not metered. Free tier deprecated in 2026; 10k free credits/mo to start. Graphiti engine is open source (Apache-2.0). — source: https://www.getzep.com/pricing (confidence 0.7)

item.title: Voyage Rerank — per token pricing (2026-11-04)
item.description: new: rerank-3 $0.05 per 1M tokens; rerank-3-lite $0.02 per 1M. rerank-2.5 includes 200M free tokens/month. Billed on query tokens x doc count + document tokens. — source: https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/pricing (confidence 0.8)

item.title: Vercel Sandbox — per second pricing (2026-11-04)
item.description: new: Billed on active CPU + provisioned memory per second; bundled with Vercel platform usage. A clear per-vCPU-hour rate is not prominently published — modeled at ~$0.10/vCPU-hour (approximate, flagged). — source: https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-sandbox/pricing (confidence 0.5)

item.title: Steel — license cost (2026-11-04)
item.description: new: Steel browser core is open-source (Apache-2.0); self-hosted, $0 software cost. Cloud: Launch free tier / $0.10 per browser-hour; Scale $250/mo at $0.08/hr. Compute borne by the user when self-hosted. — source: https://steel.dev/pricing (confidence 0.85)

item.title: Replicate — per image pricing (2026-11-04)
item.description: new: Per-run output/compute pricing across thousands of models; often a higher markup than fal for the same open model (Ideogram v3 ~$0.09 vs ~$0.03 on fal). Modeled at a representative flagship run ~$0.04. — source: https://replicate.com/pricing (confidence 0.65)
